about: Destiny Matrix report structure: 9 parts, 38 chapters, each with the matrix position it reads, the formula, and the question the position answers. Mapped from the user's own datemyst.com report (15.09.1989) on 2026-11-13 and checked against our calculator. Positions use our keys (matrix.js); `site` is datemyst's letter. Questions are written in our own words in Mongolian.

letters.J: bottom.inner — D+E (entry to the relationship channel)
letters.N: right.inner — C+E (entry to the money channel)
